ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity (white/off-white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity (black) region forming an 'anchor' shape extending from the peduncle to the median notch. High-intensity (white) regions occupy the majority of both lateral lobes. Discrete low-intensity circular spots are observed on the right lobe at [x=0.75, y=0.55] and [x=0.82, y=0.40]. Diffuse dark mottling is concentrated along the inferior boundary of the left lobe and the medial-inferior boundary of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 62 degrees and a depth ratio of 0.18 relative to total vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration map across both lobes. The left lobe displays micro-peaks of 3-6 pixel amplitude. The right lobe displays macro-serration, including a significant deep rectangular indentation at [x=0.88, y=0.15] along the trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve extending from the central notch toward the lateral tips, with the right lobe showing a slightly steeper upward sweep than the left.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast white pixel clusters corresponding to barnacle colonization are located at the distal tips of both lobes. Several dark, roughly circular ring-like scars are visible on the interior medial surface of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the right lobe, oriented vertically between [y=0.30] and [y=0.60]; two smaller linear marks are visible on the lower-left lobe near the central black region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on distal tips; significant irregular notch/indentation on the upper-right trailing edge suggesting prior physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Diffuse yellowish-green pixel patches across the white regions of both lobes, indicating superficial biofilm accumulation.
